examples.description: Import Ultralytics data.yaml for YOLOZU eval entrypoint.

tools.summary: Run Ultralytics inference and export YOLOZU predictions.json with protocol and export_settings metadata.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Write schema-valid predictions without ultralytics runtime.

writes.description: Writes YOLOZU predictions JSON from Ultralytics inference.

examples.description: Ultralytics export with NMS-applied protocol metadata.
examples.command: python3 tools/export_predictions_ultralytics.py --model yolo11n.pt --dataset data/coco-yolo --split val2017 --conf 0.25 --iou 0.45 --protocol nms_applied --wrap --output reports/pred_ultralytics.json

examples.description: CI-friendly contract smoke without ultralytics runtime.
examples.command: python3 tools/export_predictions_ultralytics.py --model yolo11n.pt --dataset data/smoke --split val --max-images 1 --protocol nms_applied --dry-run --wrap --strict --output reports/pred_ultralytics_dry_run.json

tools.summary: Convert YOLOv5 outputs (save-txt or xyxy JSON) into YOLOZU predictions.json with recorded export_settings.

examples.description: Convert YOLOv5 detect save-txt outputs to predictions.json.
examples.command: python3 tools/export_predictions_yolov5.py --dataset data/coco-yolo --split val2017 --labels-dir runs/detect/exp/labels --protocol nms_applied --output reports/pred_yolov5.json

tools.summary: Run Detectron2 inference and export YOLOZU predictions.json with protocol/export_settings metadata.

writes.description: Writes YOLOZU predictions JSON from Detectron2 outputs.

examples.description: Detectron2 export for YOLOZU eval.
examples.command: python3 tools/export_predictions_detectron2.py --dataset data/coco-yolo --split val2017 --config configs/detectron2/faster_rcnn_R_50_FPN_1x.yaml --weights runs/d2/model_final.pth --score-thr 0.25 --protocol nms_applied --output reports/pred_detectron2.json

tools.summary: Run MMDetection inference and export YOLOZU predictions.json with protocol/export_settings metadata.

writes.description: Writes YOLOZU predictions JSON from MMDetection outputs.

examples.description: MMDetection export for YOLOZU eval.
examples.command: python3 tools/export_predictions_mmdet.py --dataset data/coco-yolo --split val2017 --config configs/mmdet/faster_rcnn_r50_fpn_1x_coco.py --checkpoint runs/mmdet/epoch_12.pth --score-thr 0.25 --protocol nms_applied --output reports/pred_mmdet.json

tools.summary: Unified OpenCV-DNN exporter with preprocess/decode presets, IO dump, and backend/target controls.

writes.description: Writes YOLOZU predictions JSON via OpenCV DNN.
Optional IO tensor dump JSON for debugging.

examples.description: Unified OpenCV-DNN export with auto decode and IO dump.
examples.command: python3 tools/export_predictions_opencv_dnn_unified.py --dataset data/coco-yolo --split val2017 --onnx path/to/model.onnx --imgsz 640 --decode auto --preprocess yolo_letterbox_640 --dnn-backend opencv --dnn-target cpu --dump-io reports/opencv_dump_io.json --output reports/pred_opencv.json
